# Questions, plans and worries about something that hasn't happened, and real symptoms described as a condition.
none | self | What if I get chest pain again? | !present "chest pain" chest pain
none | self | If I have trouble breathing, should I go in? | !present "trouble breathing" breathing difficulty

none | self | For example, sudden weakness would worry me. | !present "sudden weakness" sudden weakness
none | self | I'm worried about having a stroke someday. | !present "having a stroke" stroke

none | self | How would I know if I was coughing up blood? | !present "coughing up blood" coughing blood

none | self | I'm scared of passing out while driving. | !present "passing out while driving" fainting

warn | self | Is crushing chest pain a sign of a heart attack? |
warn | self | Unless my chest pain gets worse, I'll wait for my appointment. | present "my chest pain" chest pain
warn | self | If I lie down I can't breathe. | present "I can't breathe" breathing difficulty
warn | self | If I walk fast I get chest pain. | present "I get chest pain" exertional chest pain
warn | self | Whenever I climb stairs, my chest feels tight. | present "my chest feels tight" exertional chest tightness
